newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL THREATEN TO TAKE APPEAL TO FIFA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL THREATEN TO TAKE APPEAL TO FIFA.

text.p: Real Madrid threatened to appeal to the world governing body FIFA on Thursday to overturn a ruling by the Spanish Football Federation forcing them to play Sunday's league match at Tenerife.
Real failed to have the match postponed by the Spanish federation after complaining they were missing 10 players through injury and international duty.
"The right is reserved to take to international sporting bodies the special interpretation of the norms...showing unequal treatment," the club said in a statement.
Atletico Madrid and Real Betis succeeded in having fixtures postponed in similar circumstances earlier this season.
"We're not the first to start this," said club president Lorenzo Sanz.
